summary: Kerb where cars park, backing onto a large garden; homes 18-22 m away.

best_section.where: West kerb of Taringa Parade just after the bend, beside a large lawn with a set-back house

drivers.seclusion: Large garden and trees on the west side; nearest mapped dwellings 18-20 m away (at 183, 187 and 217 m), with houses 10 m or closer elsewhere on the stretch.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed kerbside lane with parked cars; room to pull in at the kerb, no gate or barrier.
drivers.traffic: Through residential street with steady traffic.
drivers.convention: Cars park along this kerb in both images, so a van would not stand out.

flags: Dwellings 10-25 m away on the same side
Houses 8-12 m from the kerb for much of the first 150 m
Witton Creek about 118 m away; lowest ground 45.8 m
sun_shade: Street trees and the garden's trees shade the kerb from the west; afternoon sun is partly blocked.
